strings.acceptrisk: I understand that disabling email verification can be a security issue.
strings.acceptrisk_help: Disabling email verification can potentially allow a user to authenticate as another user.
strings.authconfirm: This action will grant permanent API access to Moodle for the authenticated account. This is intended to be used as a system account for managing files owned by Moodle.
strings.authconnected: The system account is now connected for offline access
strings.authnotconnected: The system account was not connected for offline access
strings.createfromtemplate: Create an OAuth 2 service from a template
strings.createfromtemplatedesc: Choose one of the OAuth 2 service templates below to create an OAuth service with a valid configuration for one of the known service types. This will create the OAuth 2 service, with all the correct end points and parameters required for authentication, though you will still need to enter the client ID and secret for the new service before it can be used.
strings.createnewuserfieldmapping: Create new user field mapping for issuer "{$a}"
strings.deleteconfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the identity issuer "{$a}"? Any plugins relying on this issuer will stop working.
strings.deleteendpointconfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the endpoint "{$a->endpoint}" for issuer "{$a->issuer}"? Any plugins relying on this endpoint will stop working.
strings.deleteuserfieldmappingconfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the user field mapping for issuer "{$a}"?
strings.discovered_help: Discovery means that the OAuth 2 endpoints could be automatically determined from the base URL for the OAuth service. Not all services are required to be "discovered", but if they are not, then the endpoints and user mapping information will need to be entered manually.
strings.edituserfieldmapping: Edit user field mapping for issuer {$a}
strings.endpointname_help: Key used to search for this endpoint. Must end with "_endpoint".
strings.endpointurl_help: URL for this endpoint. Must use https:// protocol.
strings.issueralloweddomains_help: If set, this setting is a comma separated list of domains that logins will be restricted to when using this provider.
strings.issuerbaseurl_help: Base URL used to access the service.
strings.issuerclientid_help: The OAuth client ID for this issuer.
strings.issuerclientsecret_help: The OAuth client secret for this issuer.
strings.issuerimage_help: An image URL used to show a logo for this issuer. May be displayed on login page.
strings.issuerloginpagename: Name displayed on the login page
strings.issuerloginpagename_help: If specified, this name will be used on the login page instead of the service name.
strings.issuerloginparams: Additional parameters included in a login request.
strings.issuerloginparams_help: Some systems require additional parameters for a login request in order to read the user's basic profile.
strings.issuerloginparamsoffline: Additional parameters included in a login request for offline access.
strings.issuerloginparamsoffline_help: Each OAuth system defines a different way to request offline access. E.g. Google requires the additional params: "access_type=offline&prompt=consent". These parameters should be in URL query parameter format.
strings.issuerloginscopes: Scopes included in a login request.
strings.issuerloginscopes_help: Some systems require additional scopes for a login request in order to read the user's basic profile. The standard scopes for an OpenID Connect compliant system are "openid profile email".
strings.issuerloginscopesoffline: Scopes included in a login request for offline access.
strings.issuerloginscopesoffline_help: Each OAuth system defines a different way to request offline access. E.g. Microsoft requires an additional scope "offline_access".
strings.issuername_help: Name of the identity issuer. May be displayed on login page.
strings.issuerrequireconfirmation_help: Require that all users verify their email address before they can log in with OAuth. This applies to newly created accounts as part of the login process, or when an existing Moodle account is connected to an OAuth login via matching email addresses.
strings.issuersetup: Detailed instructions on configuring the common OAuth 2 services
strings.issuersetuptype: Detailed instructions on setting up the {$a} OAuth 2 provider
strings.issuershowonloginpage_help: If the OAuth 2 authentication plugin is enabled, this login issuer will be listed on the login page to allow users to log in with accounts from this issuer.
strings.issuersmtpsystememail_help: If specified, this email will be used to connect a system account for sending email via SMTP. This is required for some OAuth 2 services (e.g. Microsoft). Please check the documentation for your OAuth 2 service to see if this is required.
strings.issuerusein_help: OAuth 2 services can be used for internal services, on the login page, SMTP with XOAUTH2, or both login page and internal services, if required.
strings.privacy:metadata: The OAuth 2 services plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.systemaccountconnected_help: System accounts are used to provide advanced functionality for plugins. They are not required for login functionality only, but other plugins using the OAuth service may offer a reduced set of features if the system account has not been connected. For example repositories cannot support "controlled links" without a system account to perform file operations.
strings.usebasicauth: Authenticate token requests via HTTP headers
strings.usebasicauth_help: Utilise the HTTP Basic authentication scheme when sending client ID and password with a refresh token request. Recommended by the OAuth 2 standard, but may not be available with some issuers.
strings.userfieldexternalfield_help: Name of the field provided by the external OAuth system.
strings.userfieldinternalfield_help: Name of the Moodle user field that should be mapped from the external field.
